Gloaming Lift.name: Gloaming Lift
Gloaming Lift.description: The shadow grips a ledge, railing or pipe above and hauls the user up a building face or across a street-wide gap, or lowers them from a height at a safe pace. It can carry a single other person in its free arm, lifting someone off a ledge or out of a flooded street along the way. Strain: moderate.
